hooks.name: Sandbox Security Guard
hooks.description: Reviews every saved file under src/sandbox/ for host escapes and process leaks before the change is accepted.

action.prompt: A file under src/sandbox/ was just saved. Review the change against .kiro/steering/sandbox-security.md and report any finding with file and line: (1) no host `fs`, `child_process`, `node:*` module, `process` or `require` object is reachable from legacy code inside the vm context, and the virtual require() still resolves only relative paths inside the in-memory module map; (2) the 256 MB heap cap and the 3000 ms per-probe watchdog are still enforced; (3) every spawned worker or child process is killed on timeout, crash and pool close, so no process can leak; (4) messages to and from workers are still typed JSON-RPC 2.0 validated at runtime. Then run `npx vitest run src/sandbox` and report the result. Do not weaken a limit or a test to make it pass.
